calls.reason: An FBI warning from December 2024 and Trend Micro's observations of criminal forums in 2024–25 show that scammers were using AI video and voice impersonation well before the post. The 'among the first' timing is loose but fits a plain reading.

This is a hedged forecast for 2026, and the year has not ended. The DetectDeepfakes counts include non-scam incidents and leave out the years before 2024, and TRM Labs measures losses, not incident counts against all history.

The International AI Safety Report says many tools are free or low-cost and realistic, but nothing tests convincing video of arbitrary people at near-zero cost in February 2026. The evidence is broad and adjacent, not a direct test.
